Nice, congrats on the NerdQX. Don't pick a revision by hand. Go to harlolabs.com, open the firmware tool, select your exact miner model, and it shows the latest release for it. If it's already running Harlo OS, use the Firmware updates section with the OTA image so you keep your Wi-Fi and settings.

JD's confirming the exact build for the NerdQX. Fastest route is our Discord right now, discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post and mention @nullhashrate. Otherwise his answer lands here or by email.

Got it, arrived today. Plug it in and check what version the dashboard already shows before flashing anything, since a factory install wipes your Wi-Fi and settings. If it's on an older build, use the OTA image in Firmware updates on harlolabs.com for your model.

What version is it showing now?
I jumped the gun and flashed it with Rev 5 1. its running 4.9TH
